summary: One instrument held at LTP by client a and at Quote by client b: the broker gets the quote stream before the ltp stream is dropped, nothing when a leaves and comes back while b holds Quote, and the ltp stream before the quote stream is dropped when b leaves.

notes: Frames follow the INDstocks price socket's documented shape (indmoney_adapter.py:575-583: mode, instrument, timestamp in ms, data) with fractional prices so a price's JSON type is not what differs.

The web subscribes each mode on its own and sends no unsubscribe while another mode holds the instrument (indmoney_adapter.py:294-459); the frames the desktop sends the broker are the desktop's own (IndmoneyFeed::mode_change_frames, a gapless change on the manager's one effective mode).

deviations.reason: INDstocks sends OI as 0 when it has none (an equity's OI); the web's own get_value reads a 0 as 'nothing new' and keeps the last value, but with none to keep it sends the 0 (indmoney_adapter.py:651-665). The desktop leaves out a field with no value: a field the stream did not give a value is left out, never sent as 0 (docs; openalgo#2376).
